text: The Polish PDO covers the Podhale highlands. The cheese is made only in the grazing season, from sheep's milk with at most 40 % cow's milk, and the matured rennet cheese is ground with salt to a paste. The registered specification keeps temperatures, salt and ripening time to the producers, and the public summaries do not state them.
